title: 15 Beautiful & Meaningful Chinese Idioms for Tattoos
description: Explore beautiful and meaningful Chinese idioms (chengyu) that make deep and inspiring tattoo choices. Complete with pinyin, English translations and stroke cards.
intro: Chinese calligraphy tattoos have been popular in the West for decades. However, instead of tattooing single words like 'love' or 'strength', tattooing a Chengyu (four-character idiom) offers a much deeper, poetic, and classic way to express your philosophy of life. Here are some of the most beautiful and inspiring Chinese idioms perfect for tattoos.

title: Romantic Chinese Idioms About Love and Relationships
description: Discover romantic and poetic Chinese idioms (chengyu) to express love, devotion, and character bonds. Complete with Pinyin and English translations.
intro: Love has been a central theme in Chinese literature for thousands of years. Chinese idioms offer a deeply poetic, aesthetic way to describe devotion, destiny, and eternal relationships. Whether you want to impress your partner or study Mandarin romantic literature, these idioms are essential.

title: Inspiring Chinese Idioms About Success & Hard Work
description: Learn motivational Chinese idioms (chengyu) about achieving success, working hard, overcoming obstacles and self-improvement.
intro: Determination and resilience are highly praised in Chinese traditional culture. Many classic idioms originate from legends of ancient figures overcoming extreme adversity. Here are some of the most inspiring Chinese idioms to motivate you in your career, studies, and personal goals.
